start: app.mettleup.fit on a signed-out device, Sign in card; an owner with a PIN

steps.action: Type the 10-digit mobile number in "Your mobile number" (+91 is already there)
user_sees: The number as typed; hint under the PIN box "No PIN yet? Ask your gym owner for a sign-in code, and type it here."
must_not: More than 10 digits accepted

steps.action: Type the 6-digit PIN in "PIN (6 digits)", tap "Sign in"
user_sees: Button reads "Signing in…"
The gym opens on its first page, with owner pages (money totals, Settings) there
must_not: The PIN shown in clear
Another gym's records shown
An owner landing with staff-only rights
A "Set your own PIN" prompt after a PIN sign-in

start: Sign in card; an owner holding a one-time code made on another signed-in device

steps.action: Type the mobile number, type the 6-digit code in the PIN box, tap "Sign in"
user_sees: The gym opens
Sheet "Set your own PIN" (no PIN yet) or "Choose a new PIN?" (has one)
must_not: The same code working a second time
The code working after its 30 minutes

start: "Create my gym" got no answer; the form shows "Sign in instead"

steps.action: Tap "Sign in instead"
user_sees: The Sign in card with the mobile number already typed in
must_not: The number lost or changed on the way

steps.action: Type the PIN just chosen, tap "Sign in"
user_sees: The new gym opens if it was made; else "That PIN or code is wrong, or the code has expired…"
must_not: A second gym made for the same mobile number

start: iPhone, the admin app opened from the home screen for the first time

steps.action: Open the app
user_sees: "Welcome to the admin app. Please sign in once more here. iPhone keeps this app apart from Safari. After this, you stay signed in."
"Owner and forgot your PIN? Open MettleUp in Safari, where you are still signed in. Go to More → Staff & sign-in, tap “Make sign-in code” and type that code here."
must_not: The note shown in Safari or on Android

steps.action: Sign in with mobile number and PIN; close and reopen the app from the home screen
user_sees: Still signed in
must_not: A sign-in asked on every open

steps.action: Tap "Sign in" with 9 digits in the mobile box
user_sees: "Type a 10-digit mobile number, like 98290 12345."
must_not: A call made to the server

steps.action: Type 5 digits in the PIN box, tap "Sign in"
user_sees: "Type your 6-digit PIN, or the code your gym owner gave you."
must_not: A call made to the server

steps.action: Type a wrong PIN
user_sees: "That PIN or code is wrong, or the code has expired. Ask the gym owner for a new code. If you are the owner, make one on a device where you are signed in. (<n> tries left)"
must_not: Words that tell whether the number has an account or a code waiting
The gym opening

steps.action: Keep typing wrong PINs until none are left
user_sees: "That PIN or code is wrong. Too many tries. Wait 15 minutes, or get a new code."; then "Too many tries for this number. Wait 15 minutes, or get a new code."
must_not: Endless guesses
The right PIN refused for longer than the words say

steps.action: Sign in with a number that was removed from the gym, or a gym MettleUp has paused
user_sees: The wrong-PIN words for a removed person; the paused-gym words for a paused gym
must_not: A removed person getting in

start: A device where an owner is signed in

steps.action: Close the browser, open app.mettleup.fit again the next day
user_sees: The gym opens with no sign-in asked
must_not: A sign-in asked on every open
Another person's session opened

steps.action: Staff & sign-in → "Sign out of this device" → "Sign out"
user_sees: Sheet "Sign out of this device?"; then the welcome page with "You are signed out of this device."
must_not: Sign out allowed while saved items wait to send: the button is off and the words say to wait for "All sent"
The gym's records left readable on the device after sign-out

steps.action: Sign in again with mobile number and PIN
user_sees: The same gym, the same role
must_not: The old notice still on the page after signing in

steps.action: With the panel open in two tabs, sign out in one
user_sees: The other tab reloads to the welcome page by itself
must_not: The other tab still showing, and saving into, the gym

start: Sign in card, then the gym, as an owner

steps.action: Sign in and look at what the role can open
user_sees: Everything, including money totals and the people list
must_not: The PIN or code kept on the device or shown in the address bar
The mobile number sent anywhere but the gym server
Staff phone numbers shown to non-owners
A wrong try revealing that a number belongs to a gym
